name: Barlin
source: Barlin, formerly the Khan's Magister of Secrets and Queen Remy's lover, aided Karder in escaping from prison. He met with Karder at the Tower of the Moon Inn, where he revealed that the queen had dismissed him and was conspiring to help the Wakabian cult seize control of the land. Barlin proposed a plan: they would travel to Gaunteinguk, where his influence remained strong. From there, Karder could begin reclaiming his Khaganate, starting with the limited but crucial support of Barlin's family.
